title: Derived pullback and derived tensor preserve D_QCoh
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. The derived pullback $Lf^*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback] sends $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y)$ into $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category], and for objects $K,L$ of $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ the derived tensor product $K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_X}L$ lies in $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$.

source.place: Lemma 36.3.8 (perfect-lemma-quasi-coherence-pullback, Tag 08DW) part (1) and Lemma 36.3.9 (perfect-lemma-quasi-coherence-tensor-product, Tag 08DX) part (1)

proof.text: For each x in X choose an affine neighborhood V of f(x), and then an affine neighborhood U of x contained in f inverse image V. Apply [lem-pc-derived-pullback-qcoh-component] in each degree on U. These opens cover X, as checked pointwise. Apply Mathlib SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.of_coversTop to glue every cohomology sheaf, giving the first conjunct.

For each degree apply [lem-pc-derived-tensor-qcoh-component] on all affine opens of X. Mathlib iSup_affineOpens_eq_top proves that these cover X; IsQuasicoherent.of_coversTop glues the restricted cohomology sheaves. This gives the second conjunct.
